reading.title: Touch It, Hear It
reading.purpose: Hear words that tell what we feel and hear.
paras: Touch with your hands. The cat's tummy is soft. The tree bark is bumpy. Honey is sticky on your fingers.
Listen with your ears. Trucks on the street are loud. A sleeping baby is quiet. Our hands and ears tell us about the world.

qs.q: Honey is sticky. What does sticky mean?
qs.why: Honey is sticky on your fingers, like glue.
The reading says trucks on the street are loud.

qs.q: What do we use to feel something bumpy?
qs.why: We touch with our hands, so we feel bumpy bark with our hands.

reading.retellFrame: A ___ thing is soft, and a ___ thing is loud.
